title: Power of LLMs in your editor
body: Write code faster with the latest large language models from Gemini, Google PaLM, and Replit.
intro: Lyra is evolving into more than just the models. It supports an entire ecosystem — from authoring through deployment, with the same primitives.

fast.title: Fast
fast.body: Streaming-first APIs land payloads in milliseconds, even on the slowest connections.

powerful.title: Powerful
powerful.body: Composable primitives that scale from a side project to an enterprise rollout.

security.title: Security
security.body: Hardened defaults, audited dependencies, and least-privilege access on by default.

aiPowered.title: AI powered
aiPowered.body: Smart suggestions, automated workflows, and contextual assistance built in.
